method: Fresh web searches followed by primary repository README inspection; no implementation tests executed.

finding: No direct MoonBit Android binary XML decoder candidate surfaced in the returned web results. Some strict queries returned unrelated material, so web searches have no reliable zero-result count.

primary_sources_inspected.name: moonbit-community/xml-mbt
primary_sources_inspected.finding: XML 1.0/Namespaces 1.0 pull parser. README explicitly requires caller-supplied XML text and Reader::from_string/NamespaceReader::from_string. No Android binary chunk decoder is described.

primary_sources_inspected.name: moonbitstack/moonxml
primary_sources_inspected.finding: HTML/XML/SVG text trees, CSS selectors and XPath; no Android binary XML decoder is described.

primary_sources_inspected.name: thy7/mbt.xml (thy1016/moonxml)
primary_sources_inspected.finding: XML text parsing/serialization, XML editions, namespaces and text encodings; parse accepts XML source strings. No Android binary XML decoder is described.

primary_sources_inspected.name: moonbitlang/awesome-moonbit
primary_sources_inspected.finding: Lists text XML parsing and other ecosystem packages; no AXML decoder listing located. Curated lists are not exhaustive.

primary_sources_inspected.name: androguard/axml-parser
primary_sources_inspected.finding: Directly overlapping AXML/ARSC parsing, manifest metadata and CLI exist in Rust with optional Python bindings. This establishes existing functionality outside MoonBit, not an existing MoonBit implementation.

limitations: Search engine indexing, spelling and query interpretation can miss public work.
Gitee/GitLink checks used indexed web search, not exhaustive platform APIs.
README inspection identifies advertised scope and does not prove absence from every source file or branch.
Private repositories, unpublished work and private contest submissions are outside this review.
